name: Inbox Zero, For Real
tagline: Empty the inbox — and keep it empty.
rationale: Email runs most people's day instead of the other way round. This crew takes it back: one bot drives the inbox to zero, one surfaces what actually needs you, one drafts the replies with full thread context but never sends, one clears the newsletter noise, and one guards the money items buried in the pile. Read-and-draft first, so you stay on every send.

members.name: Inbox Zero
members.reason: Files the noise to zero every weekday, so the inbox is a to-do list again rather than a graveyard.

members.name: Dewey
members.reason: Watches Gmail and surfaces only the mail that genuinely needs you, so nothing important hides in the pile.

members.name: loom
members.reason: Gathers the related threads first, then drafts the reply with real context, and never sends, archives or deletes on its own.

members.name: Newsletter Cleanup
members.reason: Audits months of newsletters into a review page and unsubscribes only from what you approve.

members.name: Watchdog
members.reason: Sweeps the inbox weekly for renewals, receipts and expiring trials, so money items don't slip past.
